svg.title: RustOS iconset SVG iconsheet
svg.desc: A dark-mode RustOS vector icon sheet with reusable 24 by 24 symbols for window decorations, iconbar applications, task switcher, menus, brand marks, status and connectivity.

g.text: SVG ICONSET / SYSTEM PICTOGRAMS / 24PX MASTER GRID
Fast motor recognition for frame controls
Spatial memory and app state cues
PRINCIPLES: silhouette first • familiar metaphors • low-detail 24px masters • orange only for identity, confirmation, critical attention • transparent fills signal active zones without adding clutter
